adjudicated.labeler: Claude (one labeller; not dual-labelled, so the corpus is not golden)

labelNotes: Supply: VCCA and VCCB both print 1.65 MIN / 5.5 MAX in Recommended Operating Conditions; identical tuples, so one MIN and one MAX label (cited on the VCCA line). Leakage: II (control inputs) prints '±0.5' under TYP and '±2' under MAX (columns checked with pdftotext); labelled as magnitudes 0.5 TYP and 2 MAX since the guide has no rule for ±. Its VCCA/VCCB = 1.65 V to 5.5 V conditions are not allowed keys and are omitted. Bus-hold currents IBHL, IBHH, IBHLO, IBHHO (15-900 uA) are bus-hold sustaining/overdrive currents, not input leakage, so excluded (judgement call). ICC is not on pages 6-8, so quiescent is ABSENT. Abs max: supply voltage (VCCA, VCCB) and input voltage VI (A port, B port, control inputs) all print 6.5 V MAX: one distinct tuple, cited on the supply line. VO rows are output voltages and the 'VCCx + 0.5' rows are expressions; not labelled.
